what: Ran a job on a parallel branch again (1y04 alongside PR #26); its squash conflicts on CHANGELOG.md, so the verified landing can't merge and the job reruns on current main.
why: Every job appends to CHANGELOG.md (and often docs/decisions.md), so hand-run parallel branches always collide; Athena can't re-verify a stale candidate on a new base. Operator goes serial until parallel landing handles shared append files.
